MktCalcInsightObjectDef.description: This score aggregates the Marketing Engagement Score and the Marketing Fit Score. The Overall Marketing Score helps you decide when to send a potential customer to your sales team.
MktCalcInsightObjectDef.expression: SELECT SUM(subquery.Engagement_Score__c) AS Engagement_Score__c, SUM(subquery.Fit_Score__c) AS Fit_Score__c, SUM(subquery.subquery_People_Score__c) AS People_Score__c, UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Unified_Individual__c FROM( SELECT FIRST(Marketing_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Engagement_Score__c) as Engagement_Score__c,Marketing_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Unified_Individual__c as Unified_Individual0__c, FIRST(Marketing_Fit_Score_VY89__cio.Fit_Score__c) as Fit_Score__c,Marketing_Fit_Score_VY89__cio.Unified_Individual__c as Unified_Individual1__c, ROUND(0.5*FIRST(Marketing_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Engagement_Score__c)+0.5*FIRST(Marketing_Fit_Score_VY89__cio.Fit_Score__c),0) AS subquery_People_Score__c, UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Unified_Individual__c FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm LEFT JOIN Marketing_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio ON (Marketing_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Unified_Individual__c = UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c) LEFT JOIN Marketing_Fit_Score_VY89__cio ON (Marketing_Fit_Score_VY89__cio.Unified_Individual__c = UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c) GROUP BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c, Marketing_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Unified_Individual__c, Marketing_Fit_Score_VY89__cio.Unified_Individual__c) AS subquery LEFT JOIN UnifiedIndividual__dlm ON (UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = subquery.Unified_Individual__c) GROUP BY Unified_Individual__c
